# Interstellar — relativistic flight through the Solar System

> A browser simulation of relativistic spaceflight: fly between planets at a meaningful fraction of the speed of light and watch time dilation, aberration and Doppler shift change what you see. Free, no registration. Built by Vladimir Podlevskikh (MSU physicist) as a teaching tool for special relativity.

- [Launch the simulation](https://space.podlevskikh.com/)

## The physics inside
Time dilation and the twin paradox made tangible, relativistic aberration of starlight, Doppler shift of stellar spectra, and the real scale of interplanetary distances at sub-light speeds.
